offers.rationale: C3 is the only candidate that passes T-1 (route avoids closed taxiway F) and R-1 and W-1, and it is conditionally safe on PILOT_EXTRA_HOLDING, with total cost $2021.40. C1 and C2 are unsafe (G-2 and T-1), and C4, C5 and C6 fail T-1 or F-1 even with the pilot concession, so no ATC concession is needed.

C3 passes F-1 with 2360 kg at landing against the 1800 kg reserve, and its 15 min holding is within the 29 min fuel-safe limit. It has the lowest total cost among the concession candidates at $2021.40, and it is the only one of them that passes T-1 and needs only G-2 resolved.
